title: Crossing the Red Sea Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Crossing of the Red Sea Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Red Sea Bible crossword: Moses, the divided waters, Pharaoh’s chariots and the pillar of fire. KJV clues from Exodus 14, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Israel is camped by the sea with an army behind them and no road ahead. Then Moses stretches out his hand, a strong east wind blows all night, and the water stands up like a wall on either side. Crossing the Red Sea builds Exodus 14 into a grid — the pillar of cloud that moved behind them, the chariots that followed, the wheels that came off in the morning watch.

The clues stay with the chapter's own detail rather than the film version, which is what makes the puzzle worth solving: the sea goes back by a strong east wind, and Israel walks on dry ground. The closing verse is the moment the walls of water are named.

clues.text: He stretched out his hand over the sea
Pharaoh’s pursuing force, six hundred chosen
Pillar that gave the camp light by night
What the waters were to them on their right hand and left

verseText: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
